Extensible Bible translation software

https://platform.bible/

This release attaches no installers. It is a fixed point in this repository's history for other
projects to build from, not a download.

The application released to users is **Paratext 10**, built from this source in
[`paranext/paratext-10-studio`](https://github.com/paranext/paratext-10-studio). See
[LICENSING.md](https://github.com/paranext/paranext-core/blob/main/LICENSING.md) for how the source
and the released binary are licensed.

To run Platform.Bible itself, build it from source with the
[developer install instructions](https://github.com/paranext/paranext-core#developer-install).
